description: This file is a shell script used for testing the output of git push porcelain commands in various scenarios, including normal push, forced push, atomic push, and dry-run. It defines functions to create commits, set up repositories, and run multiple test cases to verify git push output for different protocols and conditions.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns their OIDs to shell variables.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Extracts an abbreviated object ID from a full commit hash.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats the output of git commands to replace commit hashes and URLs with placeholders for consistent testing.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats the expected output and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: create_upstream_template
methods.description: Initializes a bare upstream repository with some commits for testing.

methods.name: setup_upstream
methods.description: Sets up an upstream repository, cloning and configuring it.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up both an upstream repository and a working clone environment, configuring branches and remotes.

methods.name: run_git_push_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Runs a series of tests to verify the output of 'git push --porcelain' in various scenarios and protocols.

methods.name: run_git_push_dry_run_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Runs tests to verify the output of 'git push --porcelain --dry-run' under different conditions.
